Hey team — quick note on DST and cross-region meetings: Europe switches to DST a week earlier than the US in 2026 (makes a 1-hour shift depending on date), so when we propose slots spanning US/EU/APAC, double-check CET/CEST differences. For bookings spanning late April/early May it's easy to get a one-hour mismatch.

If we're using the calendar invite, please ensure the invite explicitly shows both JST and PDT/CET times in the description and includes a link to a world-clock converter.

Also, if Koyo has EU-based participants, Option B around 14:00 CET will be much more comfortable for them.

—Logan
Logan Wright
